home.title: Sercon Gestoría
home.subtitle: More than 40 years at your service
home.description: At Sercon Gestoría we have a group of professionals that we put at your service to resolve your administrative procedures. Our objective is to avoid worries and save you time and headaches when dealing with the Administration.
home.contactText: If you have any questions you would like to clarify, do not hesitate to contact our office. We will respond as soon as possible.

fiscal.title: Tax and Accounting
fiscal.description: We have a team of more than 100 expert advisors in accounting and tax matters for companies.

laboral.title: Labor
laboral.description: We offer a global service that includes labor matters and payroll administration, according to your needs. In our labor office we carry out the complete outsourcing of personnel administration and preventive or contentious advice.

legal.title: Legal
legal.description: Our services cover tax advice, filling out and filing tax returns, support in administrative procedures and legal advice.

sucesiones.title: Inheritance
sucesiones.description: Specialized advice on inheritances and successions.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: More than 40 years of experience at your service
about.welcome: Welcome to our website. We are a prestigious administrative office formed by an excellent human team that covers a wide range of services to make your relationship with the Administration simpler.
about.mission: Our mission is to guarantee you quality, rigor and professionalism in each of the services we offer, resolve your doubts and help you improve your management, as well as optimize your results.
about.experience: From the experience, knowledge and technological means we have, we offer you personalized attention based on respect and confidentiality of all your data, in accordance with professional secrecy.
about.objective: Our objective is to be a company valued by clients, whose expectations are met, committed to its obligations before the Administration and always seeking the best legislative advantages.
about.advice: We will be happy to advise you comprehensively on all the procedures you need to carry out.
about.visit: Visit us. We are in Ourense, Calle Peña Trevinca, 35 Bajo - 32005
